# Security Policy

## Hotfixes

We use hotfixes that are releases for specific, 
high-priority issues, which cannot wait for the 
next release cycle. These will be released as a 
new minor version (e.g. x.x.1) as soon as the 
fix is implemented and tested. It is highly 
recommended that you apply these hotfixes as 
soon as you possibly can, as they may address 
severe security vulnerabilities.

> **NOTE:** Hotfix patches/updates won't be 
fully utilized until after Release Versioning
has begun, in the meantime pay attention to the
new patches that are made available via the
versioned updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Should you find any security-related issue, 
please _do not share them openly_ in the issue 
tracker. We have a dedicated mailbox where we 
keep track of them:

<issues@dragonstone-lang.org>
